answer: Make every reward claim pass through the shared garden: to enter, an agent publishes a cipher — a fresh encrypted commitment binding its work to the epoch beacon — that only independent established verifiers can open and check. Each verifier may open only a handful of ciphers per epoch, and each risks its own standing if it vouches for a clone, so a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand scarce verifier slots while one honest agent needs one. Rewards thaw like a glacier, released slowly over later epochs, so a burst of clones cannot grab and run.
